verdict.rationale: 2FAS is a 2FA authenticator and password manager, not an AI assistant or agent. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in MCP servers to use their tools is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships any agent or tool-consuming capability; its llms.txt and markdown docs only make it readable by agents, and it states 'Public API: None'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
